item.text: The code currently expires invitations after 14 hours, counts revoked and expired invitations as seats, and creates accepted memberships with an inactive status. I’m also adding checks for duplicate addresses and the accepting account, restoring former memberships, and clearing affected session defaults.

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/server/repositories/usage-repository.ts');s=p.read_text();s=s.replace('import { toIsoTimestamp }', 'import * as memberRepo from \"./member-repository\";\\nimport * as invitationRepo from \"./invitation-repository\";\\nimport { toIsoTimestamp }');s=s.replace('  if (row) return toUsage(row);','  const seatsUsed = (await memberRepo.countActiveMembers(orgId)) +\\n    (await invitationRepo.countPendingInvitations(orgId));\\n  if (row) return { ...toUsage(row), seatsUsed };');s=s.replace('.values({ orgId, measuredAt: toIsoTimestamp(new Date()) })','.values({ orgId, seatsUsed, measuredAt: toIsoTimestamp(new Date()) })');s=s.replace('seatsUsed: seats?.value ?? 0,','seatsUsed: (seats?.value ?? 0) + await invitationRepo.countPendingInvitations(orgId),');p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/usage-service.ts');s=p.read_text().replace('await usageRepo.incrementUsage(payload.orgId, { seatsUsed: 1 });','await usageRepo.recomputeUsage(payload.orgId);').replace('await usageRepo.incrementUsage(payload.orgId, { seatsUsed: -1 });','await usageRepo.recomputeUsage(payload.orgId);');p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/repositories/invitation-repository.ts');s=p.read_text();a=s.index('/**\\n * Pending invites hold a seat');b=s.index('export async function countPendingInvitations',a);s=s[:a]+'/** Only unaccepted, unrevoked and unexpired invitations reserve seats. */\\n'+s[b:];p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/server/services/invitation-service.ts');s=p.read_text().replace(' * Accepting runs unauthenticated: the token is the credential, so there is no\\n * "'`Actor` to scope against and every check has to come off the stored row.'"',' * Acceptance checks the stored invitation against the authenticated account.').replace(' * Re-issuing does not mint a new row: the original is revoked and replaced so',' * Re-issuing revokes the original and creates a replacement so');p.write_text(s)
PY"
